column_description: A VARCHAR(30) primary key for each assessment (e.g., 'AB001').
An enum (assessmenttype_enum) capturing the assessment type (Initial, Emergency, Routine, Follow-up).
An enum (assessmentmethod_enum) for how the assessment was done (Phone, Self-report, In-person, Telehealth).
A SMALLINT indicating assessment duration in minutes (e.g., 45).
An enum (assessmentlanguage_enum) describing which language was used (Chinese, French, Spanish, English, Other).
An enum (assessmentvalidity_enum) capturing validity (Questionable, Invalid, Valid).
An enum (responseconsistency_enum) describing response consistency (Medium, High, Low).
An enum (symptomvalidity_enum) describing symptom validity (Questionable, Valid, Invalid).
A VARCHAR(20) FK referencing Patients(PatKey), linking the assessment to its patient.
